title: Open source attributions
description: The open source software that powers Savlo, with its licenses and copyright notices.

content.text: Savlo is built on free software. This page collects the copyright notices and licenses of the third-party components we distribute, both on this site and in the mobile app.

The icons on this site come from **Lucide**, an open source set of more than 1,700 icons released under the ISC license. Around 110 of those icons are derived from the **Feather** project and also carry its original MIT license. (The mobile app uses Google's Material icon set, bundled with Flutter.)

content.text: In addition: **class-variance-authority** is distributed under the **Apache-2.0** license, and **@vercel/analytics** under the **Mozilla Public License 2.0**.
The Savlo app is built with **Flutter**, released by Google under the BSD-3-Clause license, and uses several dozen third-party packages.

The full list — every component with the complete text of its license — is published at savloapp.com/licenses, and the app opens it from **Settings → About → Open source licenses**. Those same notices also ship inside the app package itself; this page covers what is distributed from the website.

footerNote: Is an attribution missing or credited incorrectly? Email us at support@savloapp.com and we will fix it.
